en.abdullah-al-shahin: (5) Abu Sulayman Ahmad bin Hawtah narrated from Ibraheem bin Iss’haq an-Nahawandi from Abdullah bin Hammad al-Ansari from Sabah al-Muzni from al-Harith bin Haseera that al-Asbagh bin Nubata who said: “I heard Ali (AS) saying: “

It's as if I see non-Arabs setting up their pavilions in the mosque of Kufa and teaching people the Qur’an as it has been revealed!” I said: “O Amirul Mo’mineen, is the Qur’an not as it has been revealed?” He said: “No, it is not. The names of seventy ones of Quraysh have been removed from it. The name of Abu Lahab has been left (in the Qur’an) just to remind the Messenger of Allah (sw) of something because he is his uncle.”
